notes: This maps measured HCU/combined ELF sections to candidate budget regions for M0 accounting; it does not prove that the linker, loader, or parent arenas physically place them there.
The game-state provider currently contains the CE object pool; do not charge that nested pool twice. M2 must rehome transient object/actor/effect allocations into dynamic_simulation.

The standalone bootstrap provider has a 1 MiB bump arena. The combined no-bootstrap machine binds the full 2.5 MiB dynamic_simulation region to that allocator; live CE high-water and map-reload behavior are not yet measured.
CRT, libc, PS2SDK user-library, and platform compatibility globals are game-process static state, not kernel-owned memory; they are charged to resident_gameplay.

runtime_region_owners.system_kernel: PS2SDK kernel, stacks, and IOP/EE communication state
runtime_region_owners.resident_gameplay: ELF NOBITS plus HCU CE game-state buffer and validator claims bitmap
runtime_region_owners.current_bsp: HCU tag cache followed by the disjoint CE structure-BSP cache
runtime_region_owners.texture_cache: HCU bitmap/texture provider; GS residency is separate
runtime_region_owners.dynamic_simulation: HCU compatibility allocator in the combined no-bootstrap profile
runtime_region_owners.dma_commands: halo-ps2 renderer DMA/VIF frame and upload chains
runtime_region_owners.checkpoint: reserved parent checkpoint/save owner; no current allocation
runtime_region_owners.audio: HCU sound-cache staging provider; SPU2 sample RAM is separate
runtime_region_owners.frame_scratch: parent HP2 section decode and map-source hash scratch

system_kernel.reason: Current-image kernel, stack, and EE RPC residency requires a guest or console measurement.

elf_static.evidence: The exact combined ELF and memory audit supply allocated file-backed section bytes; this is not a runtime peak.

resident_gameplay.reason: The fixed bootstrap claim is accounted separately; CE runtime high-water is not yet exposed.

current_bsp.reason: The disjoint tag/BSP spans are bound for bootstrap, but production map residency is not measured.

texture_cache.reason: The CE texture provider receives the region; its live peak has not been measured.

dynamic_simulation.reason: The HCU compatibility allocator is bounded to this region but does not yet publish a combined-image peak.

dma_commands.reason: The HCU machine entry has not rendered a frame or measured DMA/VIF chain occupancy.

streaming.evidence: tests/test_retail_ui_ctag_mount.py complete retail UI map-service fixture; not a production map peak.

checkpoint.reason: Reserved checkpoint storage has no measured HCU machine use.

audio.reason: CE sound staging is bound but its combined-image peak has not been measured; SPU2 is separate.

frame_scratch.evidence: tests/test_retail_ui_ctag_mount.py retail UI CTAG mount fixture; not a production map peak.

uncommitted_reserve.evidence: config/memory-budget.json keeps 5.5 MiB uncommitted; allocation into this region is forbidden.
